# Psalm 37 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 37:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Of-David. Do-not fret because-of evildoers; do-not be-envious of-those-doing injustice.
- **LOGOS:** Of David. Fret not yourself because of evildoers; be not envious of wrongdoers!
- **PNEUMA:** A psalm of David. Don't worry about the wicked or envy those who do wrong.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 37:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-He-will-bring-forth as-the-light your-righteousness, and-your-justice as-the-noonday.
- **LOGOS:** He will bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your justice as the noonday.
- **PNEUMA:** He will make your innocence radiate like the dawn, and the justice of your cause will shine like the noonday sun.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 37:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **LOGOS:** In just a little while, the wicked will be no more; though you look carefully at his place, he will not be there.
- **PNEUMA:** Soon the wicked will disappear. Though you look for them, they will be gone.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 37:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** But-the-humble shall-inherit the-land and-delight in-abundance of-peace.
- **LOGOS:** But the meek shall inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace.
- **PNEUMA:** The lowly will possess the land and will live in peace and prosperity.

## 37:14 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-sword the-wicked have-drawn and-have-bent their-bow, to-bring-down the-afflicted and-needy, to-slaughter the-upright of-way.
